info.name: Sello Auth API
info.description: Postman collection for testing Sello Ecommerce auth, customer checkout/orders, mock online payment QR, tracking, and admin flows.

request.description:
Creates an order from selected cart items.

Default body uses `paymentMethodId: 2` for online mock bank QR payment.
The test script stores `orderId`, `paymentId`, `paymentUrl`, `paymentQrPayload`, `paymentQrCodeUrl`, `mockPaymentToken`, and `mockPaymentExpiresAt`.
Open the Sello Mock Bank confirmation page generated inside the QR code. In Postman this returns HTML; in a browser it shows Confirm/Decline buttons.
Poll mock bank payment status. Expected pending before confirmation, success after Confirm, failed after Decline, expired after token TTL.

request.description: Simulate pressing Confirm on the Sello Mock Bank page. This changes payment to success and order to confirmed.
Simulate pressing Decline on the Sello Mock Bank page. This changes payment/order payment status to failed.
Legacy endpoint kept for compatibility, but backend now rejects it. Use Open Mock Bank Confirm Page or Confirm Mock Bank Payment instead.

Fetch customer order tracking data with map enrichment.

Backend behavior:
- Uses saved address latitude/longitude when available.
- Geocodes the destination with Photon when coordinates are missing, then caches them in MySQL.
- Requests an OSRM GeoJSON route from the mock shipper location to the destination.
- Falls back to a straight line if Photon or OSRM is unavailable.

Expected map payload: `data.map.origin`, `data.map.destination`, and `data.map.route.geometry.coordinates`.
